rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=12, batch_size=1, lr=7e-05, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.4, wu_soft_thresh=0.0015, wu_sigmoid_slope=10.0, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-10 (one knob vs iter-7 best). NUMBERS: lr fully mapped -> iter-8 0.0(4e-5 cliff), iter-7 0.3035(7e-5 BEST), iter-9 0.3035(8.5e-5 tie), iter-1 0.3009(1.1e-4), iter-6 0.2914(2e-4). Broad flat lr peak at 7-8.5e-5 -> LOCK lr=7e-5. FAILURE MODE: lr exhausted; hr plateau 0.3035. Next continuous knob = lambda_neg (non-negativity penalty weight in the supervised loss); base=0.7 (TPE value). ONE KNOB: lambda_neg 0.7 -> 0.4 (weaker penalty, NO param change, 12 params, lr locked 7e-5). HYPOTHESIS: if I weaken the non-negativity penalty to 0.4 I expect val hr >= 0.3035 because a lighter penalty lets the soft-thresholded residual refinement retain more fine low-mu breast-tissue contrast rather than being pushed toward the mu>=0 floor; risk = negative-mu leakage degrading the calibrated metric (hr down) -> then lambda_neg>=0.7 confirmed. Budget: ~819s.
